scripts.dev: [ -x .venv/bin/uvicorn ] || { echo '[embedder] no apps/embedder/.venv, skipping (see apps/embedder/README.md to start it)'; exit 0; }; [ -f .env ] && set -a && . ./.env && set +a; exec .venv/bin/uvicorn main:create_app --factory --port ${PORT:-3003}
scripts.test: [ -x .venv/bin/pytest ] || { echo '[embedder] no apps/embedder/.venv, skipping tests'; exit 0; }; .venv/bin/pytest -q
